brief: 8 React libs that quietly replaced expensive UI kits.

slots.postLine: real engineers use to ship faster

slots.toolTagline: Copy-paste components that look premium without the license fee.
slots.bodyText: Stop buying bloated kits. shadcn/ui gives you accessible, customizable blocks you own entirely.
slots.skill1Body: Provides accessible UI primitives and themes.
slots.skill2Body: Dashboards, admin panels, and SaaS apps.
slots.skill3Body: Minutes via CLI with automatic Tailwind config.
slots.footerNote: zero dependencies to lock you in

slots.toolTagline: Unstyled, accessible primitives that let you build custom components from scratch.
slots.bodyText: Radix handles accessibility and keyboard navigation so you never fight a rigid theme again.
slots.skill2Body: Design systems and bespoke component libraries.
slots.skill3Body: Seconds with npm install and compose.

slots.toolTagline: Utility-first CSS that removes the need for pre-built themed widget sets.
slots.bodyText: Why buy a kit when Tailwind lets you style any markup in seconds without leaving your JSX.
slots.skill1Body: Provides atomic utility classes for rapid UI.
slots.skill3Body: One plugin and a config file.
slots.skill4Body: Free, with paid Tailwind UI optional.

slots.toolTagline: High-performance forms that cut out the bloat of paid form builders.
slots.bodyText: React Hook Form minimizes re-renders and kills boilerplate, replacing expensive form plugins.
slots.skill1Body: Manages form state with minimal overhead.
slots.skill3Body: One hook and a resolver import.

slots.toolTagline: Production-ready animations that make any interface feel like a native app.
slots.bodyText: Ditch bloated motion kits. Framer Motion declaratively animates components with a few props.
slots.skill1Body: Animates DOM elements with simple JSX.
slots.skill4Body: Free MIT license for most features.

slots.toolTagline: Server-state management that replaces heavy data-grid and table SDKs.
slots.bodyText: TanStack Query caches, syncs, and paginates remote data without costly enterprise widgets.
slots.skill1Body: Fetches, caches, and updates server state.

slots.ctaBody: Ditch the subscription fatigue. Stack these open-source React libraries and ship premium interfaces today.
